summary: Full v2 audit test of OAKsphere Connect. BACKEND: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_v2_audit.py (32 cases) covering Tags CRUD+permissions+lead tagging+tag filter+delete-pull, WhatsApp templates CRUD (5 seeded) + whatsapp activity log, Notes CRUD + activities payload shape + recruiter note ownership 403, follow-up enforcement on PATCH /leads (400 without date on non-final change, supersede chain, final-status validations for Selected/Rejected/Not Interested), call-log rules (No Answer -> 400/200 + Attempted, Not Interested -> final, Invalid Number -> Invalid Lead + phone_valid False, Interview Scheduled required fields + interview record), follow-up views/counts/create/reschedule/complete(next & final)/delete + recruiter 403, users PATCH/duplicate-email/admin protection/delete-requires-transfer/transfer-leads endpoint/recruiter 403, lead delete cascade, recruiter scope 403s, dashboard/main today keys, lead saved views, settings new statuses, interview stage->lead status mapping + interview/joining delete guards, clients/jobs CRUD. 32/32 passed. Also repaired 7 stale v1 assertions in backend_test.py (they relied on pre-v2 behaviour/seed data) -> full suite now 98/98 green. FRONTEND (Playwright, admin + recruiter + mobile): dashboard 12 KPI cards + clickable kpi-fresh-leads -> /leads?view=new_leads chip active; leads filters/search/clear + URL sync; row actions call/wa/edit/delete incl. cancel & confirm; Add Lead with prefilled follow-up; lead drawer all 12 actions (note add/edit/delete, tag picker, status change with amber follow-up section, Not Interested requires reason + 'Lead closed' banner, add follow-up, assign, timeline); WhatsApp modal (5 templates, name substitution, wa.me popup); disposition modal (No Answer follow-up prefilled + error on cleared date + success, Not Interested final-status-note, no follow-up section); Follow-ups page 6 tabs + counts + search + complete(next date) moves to Completed and creates Tomorrow entry + reschedule + delete confirm; Recruiters add/edit/view-leads/transfer dialog/delete-with-leads warning/deactivate dialog/delete fresh user; Clients & Jobs create/edit/delete with confirms; Settings tags CRUD, templates CRUD + placeholder chip + preview with sample data, General tab shows all new statuses; Interviews edit/reschedule/stage/delete; Joining list/edit dialog; recruiter role guards (no delete buttons, no drawer delete/assign, no client/job write, no fu-delete, no Settings/Recruiters nav); mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow + sidebar. No console/page errors observed. All test data created was cleaned up (18 leads / 6 users / 14 tags / 5 templates / 5 clients / 6 jobs restored; teamlead + recruiter logins re-verified 200).

minor.issue: Rename does not check for duplicate names (POST /api/tags does). Two tags can end up with the same name via PATCH.

Only clears lead.next_followup_date when the deleted doc's due_date matches exactly; and after deletion an ACTIVE (non-final) lead is left with no pending follow-up, breaking the 'every active lead must have a follow-up' invariant. Verified in UI: deleting the pending follow-up of an active lead left it with no next follow-up and no warning.
due_date / next_date are not validated to be in the future — a past date is accepted, immediately creating an 'overdue' follow-up.

9 of the 18 existing leads are in active statuses (Contacted/Interested/Follow-up/Interview/New) with next_followup_date = null (UI shows '⚠ none'). Enforcement only fires on status change/call log, and seed_reference_data does not backfill, so the stated rule is not true for existing data.

dashboard today.interviews_scheduled = 2 but /api/interviews returns 0 records — some seeded leads carry interview_status='Scheduled' without a matching interviews document, so the Interviews page is empty while the KPI is non-zero.

minor.endpoint: Multiple write endpoints (tags, wa-templates, notes, leads PATCH, followups, interviews, joinings)
minor.issue: Bodies are raw dict (no Pydantic models). Arbitrary keys are persisted for interviews/joinings (`{**body}` spread in create_joining), and no type validation on dates.
Calls get_followups() six times, each re-scanning all follow-ups + users + leads (6x full scans per dashboard/page load).
UserUpdate strips None values, so team_leader_id / phone can never be cleared once set.

issues: Templates use double-brace placeholders ({{Candidate Name}}) while the spec/UI chips describe single braces; unresolved placeholders such as {{Job Role}} / {{Salary}} remain in the outgoing wa.me text (a wa-unfilled-warning is shown, but the raw braces are still sent).
Tab counts render as '…' for ~1-2s while /followups/counts resolves (6 sequential scans) — visible flicker on load.
Active leads with no follow-up show '⚠ none' but there is no saved view / filter to list them, so the enforcement gap is not actionable from the UI.

action_items: After DELETE /api/followups/{id}, if the lead is non-final and has no other pending follow-up, clear next_followup_date AND surface it (e.g. add a 'No follow-up' saved view / Action Required section)
Validate that follow-up due_date / next_date are in the future in POST /api/followups, PATCH /api/followups/{id} and /complete
Backfill next_followup_date for the 9 existing active leads (or add a one-time migration in seed_reference_data) so the 'every active lead has a follow-up' invariant holds for existing data
Reconcile interview_status on leads with the interviews collection (dashboard shows 2 scheduled interviews while /api/interviews is empty)
Replace raw dict bodies with Pydantic models on tags/wa-templates/notes/leads PATCH/followups/interviews/joinings; stop spreading **body into joining documents
Compute /api/followups/counts in a single aggregation instead of 6 get_followups() calls
Allow clearing nullable user fields (team_leader_id/phone) in PATCH /api/users
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2155 lines — well past the 700-line guideline; the follow-up enforcement logic is duplicated between update_lead, log_call and complete_followup and should be extracted into one helper (a divergence between them would silently break the invariant).

delete_followup compares lead['next_followup_date'] == f['due_date'] to decide whether to clear the lead field — string equality on ISO timestamps is brittle; query for another pending follow-up instead.
create_joining does `{...defaults, **body}` so any client-supplied key is persisted verbatim into the joinings collection.
followup_counts re-invokes the route handler six times (get_followups) — every call loads all users and all referenced leads.
update_tag / update_wa_template call update_one before checking existence, so a PATCH to a missing id performs a no-op write then 404s (harmless but misleading).

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects reproduced in v2. The remaining gaps are invariant/validation holes rather than broken flows: (1) follow-up enforcement is applied only at write time inside update_lead/log_call/complete_followup, so pre-existing leads (9 of 18) and leads whose pending follow-up is deleted by an admin end up active with next_followup_date=null; (2) follow-up dates are never checked against now(), so past dates can be scheduled; (3) leads seeded with interview_status='Scheduled' have no matching interviews document, which is why the Interviews page is empty while the dashboard KPI reads 2.
